Marissa / Neha - quick internal note to capture the current state so we can respond to Acme: 

SOC 2 status:
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type I in 2025 (controls design) - we have the Type I report available for review under NDA.
- Type II is in progress; audit fieldwork is scheduled for Jan 2027, with an expected Type II report delivery in Q1 2027 (target: end of March 2027).

Audit logging capabilities (short answers we can paste into the questionnaire):
- Admin activity logs: yes - all admin/user management actions recorded with actor, timestamp, IP, and action details. Retention configurable per account; default 90 days.
- API logs: yes - request/response metadata, status codes, token-level identifiers (redacted in exports where necessary). Logs captured at infra and application layers.
- Exportability: yes - per-account export to S3 (scheduled exports) and ad-hoc JSON/CSV exports via Console or API.
- Immutability: append-only storage for primary logs with write-once retention locks supported for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted offers tamper-evidence and cryptographic checksums.

Attachments: SOC2-Status-2026Q4.pdf (internal summary of SOC 2 timeline and what to share with customers)

If you want, I can draft short, copy-paste answers for each questionnaire section. Also can include the Audit_Logging_Design.pdf excerpt (ops-friendly diagram) for the technical team.

Samantha - thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching Acme’s questionnaire. Per our internal notes (cc’d Aditya and Neha), here are consolidated answers and attachments: 

SOC 2 / Compliance:
- Current: SOC 2 Type I completed (2025).
- Type II: in progress; fieldwork scheduled Jan 2027, expected report delivery Q1 2027 (target end of March). We can share the Type I report under NDA now and Type II once issued.
- GDPR: we support data residency controls for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted customers can request regional data handling - we’ll share our data processing addendum (DPA) on request.
- HIPAA: Redwood’s platform can be configured to support HIPAA-covered workloads (Dedicated / Private deployments + appropriate BAAs). We’re happy to discuss specifics with your legal / compliance team.

Audit logging (concise answers for questionnaire):
- Admin activity logs: yes - actor, timestamp, IP, action detail. Retention configurable (default 90 days).
- API logs: yes - request/response metadata, status code, latency, and request identifiers. Sensitive payloads are redacted when exporting.
- Exportability: yes - exports available via Console and API; large exports can be delivered to customer S3 buckets.
- Immutability: hosted offering includes tamper-evidence and cryptographic checks; Dedicated/Private can enable WORM-like retention/append-only storage.

Attached: Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire_Completed.xlsx (completed version of your questionnaire), Audit_Logging_Design.pdf (ops diagram), SOC2-Status-2026Q4.pdf (summary).

Next steps:
- I’ve completed your questionnaire (attached) - please confirm receipt and any clarifications.
- Proposed follow-up call: Thu 25 Nov, 9:30am PST (as suggested). If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.
- If you need the Type I report under NDA before the call, let me know and I’ll share the access link.
